evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/f owns one int[][] adjacency/clipping grid plus base offsets/dimensions and resets the grid to open/interior versus closed/border clipping masks.
Its mutators add/remove directional wall flags, rectangular object occupancy flags and blocked-tile state using the classic RuneScape clipping bit masks.
Its boolean query methods implement wall/object/decor reachability tests against the same directional clipping masks and local coordinates.
Historical RuneScape client sources expose the structurally and algorithmically equivalent class as CollisionMap, including the int[][] flags grid and the classic method219-style reachability logic.

proposals.note: Historical RuneScape source identity recovered from exact clipping-grid structure, mutation algorithms and reachability behavior.
